assessment: This study presents the valuable finding that the human cerebellum receives highly convergent (rather than sparse) task-related connectivity from the cortex. A compelling case is made that this convergent connectivity supports a wide variety of cognitive functions, though it will be important for future work to fully verify the cortical-to-cerebellar directionality of the results. The work will be of broad interest to cognitive neuroscientists interested in the role of connectivity in cognition.
